strings: r_c0 sadly confirms that there's not much {PRONOUN/r_c0/subject} can do for m_c, despite how the kitten struggles to breath through {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} flattened nose and tires quickly.
Some hoped m_c's odd muzzle was just visual quirk, but m_c struggles to keep up and stay active the way other kittens do, tiring easily and struggling to get used to more solid food.
